title: Cheats System
description: Full cheat code support across all cores — online DB lookup, CloudKit sync, and in-game OSD.

title: SwiftData Migration
description: Replace Realm with SwiftData for native CloudKit sync, better Swift 6 compatibility, and reduced binary size.

title: RetroAchievements
description: Full RetroAchievements integration with session management, in-game OSD overlays, hardcore mode, and leaderboards.

title: Haptics & Rumble
description: Platform-agnostic PVRumbleProtocol with GCDeviceHaptics support for external controllers and native haptic feedback.

title: Screen Recording
description: RPScreenRecorder-based screen capture with OSD indicator, clip saving, and optional streaming integration.

title: Per-Game Core Options
description: Game-specific emulator settings that override global defaults — resolution, rendering, audio filters, and more.

title: N64 Transfer Pak
description: Nintendo 64 Transfer Pak support — import Game Boy cartridge data into N64 games like Pokémon Stadium.

title: Virtual Keyboard & Mouse
description: Reusable on-screen keyboard and mouse overlay for DOS, MSX, and keyboard-driven systems.

title: Skin Browser
description: Community controller skin browser with catalog, preview, and one-tap install.

title: Netplay
description: Native SwiftUI network multiplayer — local rooms, internet play, and support for all core types.

title: DS Dual-Screen Skins
description: Dynamic dual-screen Delta-compatible skin support for DS emulators with independent screen sizing.

title: Button Mapping & MFi+
description: Persistent custom button mappings, modifier combos, and extended MFi controller input system.

title: In-Game Notifications & OSD
description: Unified toaster notification system and indicator light for achievements, save states, cheat toggles, etc.

title: JIT UX & Smart Management
description: Intelligent JIT detection, user-friendly prompts, and JIT status indicator with one-tap enable flows.

title: Localization
description: Full app localization — extract all hardcoded strings, add translations, auto-translation pipeline for future releases.

title: Companion Controller
description: Use iPhone/iPad as a wireless companion controller with extended input for high-button-count systems via AirPlay.

title: Core Updates
description: Update out-of-date native cores: Mupen64Plus, DuckStation, DeSmuME, MelonDS — video fixes, color correction.

title: Web File Manager
description: Swift-native HTTP/WebDAV server for browser-based ROM management — replaces legacy ObjC server.
